meta.name: claude-design-critic
meta.description: Audit a website or UI and de-AI it — find the patterns that make it look template-generated (in both design and copy) and return specific, prioritized fixes that push it toward editorial, premium, human-crafted. Reviews layout, color, type, spacing, motion, accessibility, AND the words. Use after building or generating any frontend, or when a site looks "fine but generic" and you can't say why.

copy.tagline: 审查网站和UI，去除模板化痕迹，给出具体改进建议。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚做完前端或UI设计，想让它看起来更高级、更人性化。
